items.title: Opening a 400-Year-Old Cryptex

items.title: Formal Verification of the Signal Protocol Using AI
items.summary: This seems like a good thing: Google Deepmind researchers used agentic AI to mathematically prove, or “formally verify,” a number of the Signal protocol’s key cryptographic guarantees­a landmark development for the widely used cryptography and AI itself. Conducted as a sort of proof-of-concept project in just four weeks, the work is significant in two ways.…

items.title: Usable Security at Luxury Hotels
items.summary: Interesting case study from luxury hotels. Attackers used a fake booking request to gain access to a reservations inbox, where they copied genuine refund requests and got fraudulent ones approved. This is a good illustration why “just don’t click on links” is bad advice. It can’t work when answering strangers’ emails is the job. Even worse, in this case the…
